query: Merge Cooking game "parts" storage slots buy - what does parts mean
sent_query: Merge Cooking game "parts" storage slots buy - what does parts mean
answer: In Merge Cooking, parts refer to individual components of items that can be merged to upgrade them. Players often sell lower-level parts to free up storage space. Merging parts allows players to create higher-level versions of items.
